title: UnicodeDecodeError (INTERNALERROR) when doctests contain Unicode

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

labels.name: plugin: doctests
labels.description: related to the doctests builtin plugin

body:
Originally reported by: **Jason R. Coombs (BitBucket: [jaraco](http://bitbucket.org/jaraco), GitHub: [jaraco](http://github.com/jaraco))**

---

Consider this test:

```
def foo():
    """
    >>> name = 'с'
    'anything'
    """
```

Note that isn't the letter 'c' but instead Cyrillic 's'.

Save it as mod.py, then invoke `pytest --doctest-modules`. It will fail with this output:
